column1: # THE RESULT.  One of the two decisive cells REPLICATES and one DOES NOT.
# 🔴 R2 is the one that matters, because p373 called cell 2 "THE DECISIVE CELL" -- the cell that
# refuted ACTION PJ's "the axis is the ORGAN" and established that German is NECESSARY for Germany.
# Re-run at n=2 the same query returned a dated, education-specific, German-jurisdiction fact.
# So "English + organ = NIL for Germany" is NOT a stable property of the cell.  It is the kind of
# result WebSearch returns sometimes, and p373 read a single draw as a property.
# 🔵 And the fact R2 returned is worth separating from the verdict: the retrieving outlet was
# FRENCH (actuia.com), not German and not English.  p373's account -- "German school policy is
# not carried in English at all" -- predicts a nil for any non-German leg.  A French-language
# aggregator carrying a KMK decision six days old is outside that account entirely.
# 🔴 WHAT THIS PASS MAY NOT CLAIM.  n=2 is a REPLICATION, not a variance estimate.  Two draws
# that disagree establish that the cell is NOT deterministic; they do not estimate how often it
# returns which.  No variance figure is published, and ACTION p373-D is NOT closed by this file --
# it is DOWNGRADED, because what it asked for (variance) needs more draws than a disagreement.
